scope: Static package structure only; not Unity import, compilation or release-build validation

checks.name: Package identity parses and matches assembly paths
Every package asset and subdirectory has metadata
Metadata has unique valid GUIDs and no orphans
Core and persistence enforce engine-free dependency boundaries
Authoritative code has no Unity, wall-clock or System.Random dependency
Laboratory assemblies require opt-in and editor/development; editor and test assemblies are editor-only
Finite source manifest matches trusted build digest
Serialized content bindings reproduce their immutable manifest digest
Manifest keeps test-only scope, internal visibility, result pointer and knowledge grants separate
Authority-reference verification rejects a mismatched pinned Git blob
Every authority-reference locator resolves to its pinned Git blob
Every source locator resolves to its pinned Git blob
Recipe-14 expansion manifest matches its separately trusted build digest
Serialized recipe-14 bindings reproduce their immutable manifest digest
Recipe-14 profile keeps recipe-scoped occurrence identity, output and TEST_ONLY boundaries
Recipe-14 source and authority references resolve to pinned Git blobs
